source: Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries (MAFF), General Directorate of Agriculture / ASPIRE program - Technical Document: "Sweet Corn Cultivation Techniques Resilient to Climate Change" (បច្ចេកទេសដាំដាំណាំពោតផ្អែមធន់នឹងការប្រែប្រួលអាកាសធាតុ), 2018
text:
Insect pests damaging sweet corn:

1. Cutworm/leaf-eating caterpillar (ដងកូវកាត់សិ្នក): damage characteristics — eats and destroys the leaf blade and the corn's silk/tassel hairs, with the damaged area on the leaf growing larger over time, causing the plant to grow slowly (stunted growth). Prevention and control: cut off and burn or bury the damaged plant parts far from the field; use yellow sticky traps; use agricultural pesticide according to the label's technical instructions.

2. Corn borer/stalk-boring caterpillar (ដងកូវចាះពោត): damage characteristics — the caterpillar eats through from the base to the leaf base, and damages all parts of the corn plant including leaves, stalk, tassel, and ear/fruit. Prevention and control: cut off and burn or bury the damaged plant parts far from the field; use yellow sticky traps and light traps; use agricultural pesticide according to the label's technical instructions.

Diseases of sweet corn and management measures:

1. Yellow leaf wilt/blight disease (ជម្ងឺទុំលឿងស្លឹក): symptoms — leaves turn yellow; spreads from one plant to another via wind and rainwater, occurring most often in the cool/cold season. Prevention and control: use disease-resistant varieties; cut or remove and burn diseased plants, or bury them in soil far from the field; use agricultural pesticide/fungicide according to label instructions.

2. Stem rot disease (ជម្ងឺរលួយដើម): symptoms — plant is shorter than normal; has dark/rotten spots at the base or middle of the stalk; the stalk collapses easily especially in the wet/rainy season when conditions are damp. Prevention and control: cut and burn or bury diseased plants far from the field; use agricultural pesticide/fungicide according to label instructions.

3. Leaf blight/leaf spot disease (ជម្ងឺរលាកស្ទបស្លឹក): symptoms — occurs on the leaf blade; the affected area appears dry and withered; can occur at any time. Prevention and control: use agricultural pesticide/fungicide according to label instructions (source repeats the symptom description under the control heading rather than giving distinct additional control steps, as noted in the original document).
